title: Full arm in empty-batch close-signal branch lacks explanation
description: The Full arm at lines 395-398 (empty-batch, close_after_first path) has no comment explaining what 'channel full on a close-signal' means operationally. 256 None items queued without consumption is extraordinary and likely indicates a deeper stall or a test-harness issue. Without a comment, a future contributor seeing this warn in logs will not understand why the channel would be full with close-signals. Add: '// Full here means 256 close-signals are queued unread — an extraordinary stall; drop the connection.'
